criteria.archived_reproduction: Repeat the frozen 4011 configuration on the archived input: >=4000 tasks and exact equality of all six action/schedule/event/task fields.
criteria.fresh_validation: Both fresh inputs must complete strictly; candidate must beat the stronger of two NMS repetitions on each input and exceed the sum of the immediately previous 3990 configuration over both inputs.
criteria.timing: Every entry <=1 second, preprocessing <=30 seconds; no partial search portfolio; 32GB process guard.
criteria.integrity: No tuning on seeds50001-50010. Keep every original attempt and report failures. Independent full movement/scheduling/task-event replay for each successful run.
